subject: Logic
title: Evaluating AND and OR
description: Learn Evaluating AND and OR in one minute.

hook.text: "I'll come if it's sunny AND I'm free." Both conditions needed. Change AND to OR and the rules shift.

buildup.text: P ∧ Q is true only when both P and Q are true. One false input makes the whole thing false.

discovery.text: P ∨ Q is true when at least one is true. It's only false when both P and Q are false.

twist.text: English "or" is often exclusive (one or the other). Logical OR is inclusive—both can be true.

climax.text: Mixing up AND and OR in conditions causes bugs in code, contracts, and legal documents constantly.

punchline.text: AND demands both. OR needs just one.

quiz.question: When is P ∧ Q (P AND Q) true?
